projects.title: Adaugo & Louis
projects.cardImageAlt: Adaugo & Louis wedding website homepage with handwritten names and a polaroid photo of calla lilies
projects.cardDescription: A handwritten, keepsake-style wedding website — designed to feel like a personal invitation.
projects.summary: A wedding website for Adaugo & Louis, designed to feel like a handwritten invitation from the couple to their guests.
projects.detailText: Notebook paper, script lettering and polaroid-style photos give the site a warm, personal feel, with sections for the couple's story, the celebration and guest notes as the details come together.
highlights: Scope: Wedding website design and build covering our story, the celebration, guest notes and updates.
Challenge: Make a website feel as personal and tactile as a paper invitation.
Status: Work in progress — details are still being added ahead of the big day.

projects.title: Jerome Nnodum
projects.cardImageAlt: Jerome Nnodum portfolio website homepage with headshot and the headline 'I'm Jerome. A Business Analyst based in London.'
projects.cardDescription: A bold personal portfolio for a London-based business analyst — built to make a strong first impression on recruiters and clients.
projects.summary: A personal brand and portfolio website for Jerome Nnodum, a London-based business analyst.
projects.detailText: The site brings his experience, skills, case studies, testimonials and qualifications together in one confident, easy-to-scan page — with a downloadable CV and LinkedIn link to turn interest into conversations.
highlights: Scope: Portfolio website design and build covering experience, skills, case studies, testimonials, education and contact.
Challenge: Present a career's worth of experience and certifications without overwhelming busy recruiters.
Outcome: A striking, memorable personal brand that makes his expertise clear at a glance.

projects.title: Scent Oud
projects.cardImageAlt: Scent Oud Shopify storefront showing a row of fragrance bottles
projects.cardDescription: A luxury Shopify storefront for a UK fragrance house — designed to make high-concentration scents feel premium and easy to buy.
projects.summary: A Shopify storefront for Scent Oud, a UK fragrance brand selling unisex extrait de parfum, fragrance oils and gift bundles.
projects.detailText: The store pairs bold, product-led imagery with clean navigation by collection, so shoppers can move quickly from discovering a scent to choosing a size or bundle and checking out.
highlights: Scope: Shopify storefront design and build covering collections, product pages, bundles, wishlist and multi-currency checkout.
Challenge: Convey a luxury, layered-fragrance positioning online, where customers can't smell the product.
Outcome: A premium, conversion-ready store with collection-led browsing, bundles and flexible payment options.

projects.title: Bilgs Studio
projects.cardImageAlt: Bilgs Studio Shopify storefront showing a 3D-printed marathon route medal frame
projects.cardDescription: A Shopify storefront for a UK studio making personalised 3D-printed race keepsakes — built to turn finish lines into orders.
projects.summary: A Shopify storefront for Bilgs Studio, a UK maker of handmade, 3D-printed medal frames and route keepsakes for runners, triathletes, hikers and cyclists.
projects.detailText: The store leads with the product and the story behind every race, then makes personalisation simple — from picking a frame to sending race details or a custom route — with a launch discount and reviews to build confidence.
highlights: Scope: Shopify storefront design and build covering the shop, custom orders, gallery, about and FAQ.
Challenge: Sell a made-to-order, personalised product online without making ordering feel complicated.
Outcome: A warm, product-led store with clear paths to order and built-in email capture for launch.

projects.title: Scaza
projects.cardImageAlt: Scaza website homepage with the headline 'Your supplier in China is waiting.'
projects.cardDescription: A clear, confident website for a cross-border payments platform helping African businesses pay suppliers in China.
projects.summary: A website for Scaza, a cross-border payments platform that helps African businesses pay suppliers in China with clarity, speed and full control.
projects.detailText: The site turns a complex financial process into a simple story — from invoice to payment — with live exchange rates, a currency converter and clear trust signals to reassure first-time users.
highlights: Scope: Web design and build covering the product story, business and individual journeys, currency converter and trust and security content.
Challenge: Make cross-border payments feel simple, transparent and trustworthy for businesses wary of hidden fees and delays.
Outcome: A polished fintech presence that explains the product quickly and drives sign-ups.

projects.title: Edjuvera
projects.cardImageAlt: Edjuvera website homepage showing a tutor reading with a child
projects.cardDescription: A warm, reassuring website for a SEND tuition and alternative provision service in Medway and Kent.
projects.summary: A new website for Edjuvera, a specialist SEND tuition and alternative provision service supporting families, schools and local authorities across Medway, Central Kent and online.
projects.detailText: The site speaks to three very different audiences at once — parents, schools and local authorities — with needs-led content, clear trust signals and simple routes to book a free consultation or refer a learner.
highlights: Scope: Web design and build covering learning needs, tuition, schools and local authorities, parent guidance, resources and tutor recruitment.
Challenge: Make a sensitive, specialist service feel warm and approachable while building trust with professionals.
Status: In progress — the site is currently in development ahead of launch.

projects.title: Hank Robotics
projects.cardImageAlt: Hank Robotics website homepage showing a drone cleaning a hotel facade
projects.cardDescription: A bold, high-impact website for a Miami drone cleaning company — built to turn property managers into quote requests.
projects.summary: A modern web presence for Hank Robotics, a Florida-based provider of drone and robotic cleaning for commercial, hospitality and residential properties.
projects.detailText: The site leads with a clear safety-first message, then guides visitors through services, industries and a simple three-step process — with instant-quote and estimate CTAs throughout to keep enquiries flowing.
highlights: Scope: Web design and build covering services, industries, locations, blog and gallery.
Challenge: Make a new, technical service feel credible and easy to understand for property and facilities decision-makers.
Outcome: A confident, conversion-focused site with location pages for local search and quote CTAs on every page.

projects.title: Seedrock Consulting
projects.cardDescription: Strategy consultancy brand and website — positioned for credibility and designed to attract high-value clients.
projects.summary: A consultancy brand and website positioned to feel strategic, composed, and credible to higher-value clients.
projects.detailText: The output focused on sharpening the firm’s presentation so the business reads clearly and confidently at first glance.
highlights: Scope: Brand direction and website design.
Challenge: Communicate expertise without relying on dense or overly corporate messaging.
Outcome: A more refined digital presence that supports premium positioning.
